name: Birla Corporation Limited
summary: Birla Corporation Limited manufactures and sells cement and clinker in India and internationally. It operates through three segments: Cement, Jute, and Others. The company offers ordinary Portland, Portland Pozzolana, and Portland slag cement under the MP Birla Cement Perfect Plus, MP Birla Cement Samrat Advanced, MP Birla Cement Ultimate Ultra, MP Birla Cement Unique, MP Birla Cement Samrat, MP Birla Cement Ultimate, MP Birla Cement Chetak, MP Birla Cement PSC, MP Birla Cement Multicem, and MP Birla Cement Concrecem brands used in bridges, dams, railway sleepers, reservoirs, industrial buildings, marine structures, cooling towers, metro lines, and airport runways.
